lighten--verb.def: To make something less heavy, or brighter.

translator--noun.def: A person who changes writing into another language.

understandable--adj.def: Easy to understand, or natural in the circumstances.

transition--noun.def: The process of changing from one state to another.

haunt--verb.def: To appear as a ghost, or to stay worryingly in the mind.

altitude--noun.def: The height of a place above sea level.
altitude--noun.ex: At this altitude the air is thin.

sniff--verb.def: To breathe in through the nose noisily or to smell something.

limb--noun.def: An arm or a leg, or a large branch.
limb--noun.ex: He lost a limb in the accident.

priceless--adj.def: So valuable that no price could be enough.

intruder--noun.def: A person who enters a place illegally.
intruder--noun.ex: An intruder broke the back window.
intruder--noun.exTr: İzinsiz giren biri arka camı kırdı.

inherit--verb.def: To receive money or a quality from an older relative.

decline--verb.def: To become less, or to politely refuse.

yield--verb.def: To produce a result or a crop, or to give way.

belongings--noun.def: The things you own and carry with you.
belongings--noun.ex: Take all your belongings with you.

feedback--noun.def: Comments about how well someone has done.

pickle--noun.def: A vegetable kept in vinegar or salty water.
pickle--noun.ex: Serve the meat with a pickle.

arctic--adj.def: Relating to the far north, or extremely cold.

secondary--adj.def: Less important than something else, or at the second stage.

pajamas--noun.ex: He came down in his pajamas.

manipulate--verb.def: To control someone unfairly, or to handle something skilfully.

liberal--adj.def: Open to new ideas and respecting personal freedom.

bun--noun.def: A small round bread, or hair tied in a round shape.

lava--noun.def: Hot melted rock that flows from a volcano.

tickle--verb.def: To touch someone lightly so they laugh.

midst--noun.def: The middle of a place or a situation.
midst--noun.ex: We were in the midst of dinner.

cuff--noun.def: The end of a sleeve at the wrist.
cuff--noun.ex: His cuff was stained with ink.

cripple--noun.def: An old and now offensive word for a disabled person.
cripple--noun.ex: The old book uses the word cripple.

bourbon--noun.def: An American whiskey made mainly from corn.

cathedral--noun.def: The main and largest church of a region.
cathedral--noun.ex: The cathedral took a century to build.

strangle--verb.def: To kill someone by pressing their throat.

roam--noun.def: A journey with no fixed direction.
roam--noun.ex: They went for a long roam.

openly--adv.ex: He spoke openly about the cost.

extract--noun.def: A concentrated substance, or a short piece from a text.
extract--noun.ex: Add a drop of vanilla extract.

extract--verb.def: To take something out, often with effort.

skilled--adj.def: Having the training to do something well.

idle--adj.def: Not working or not being used.

likewise--adv.def: In the same way, or also.
likewise--adv.ex: She left early and he did likewise.
likewise--adv.exTr: O erken çıktı, adam da aynısını yaptı.

riddle--noun.def: A question with a clever or funny answer.

ghetto--noun.def: A poor part of a city where one group is forced to live.
ghetto--noun.ex: He grew up in the ghetto.

marathon--noun.def: A long running race of about forty-two kilometres.

infant--noun.def: A very young child or baby.
infant--noun.ex: The infant slept through the noise.

humiliate--verb.def: To make someone feel ashamed in front of others.

karaoke--noun.def: Singing to recorded music for fun.

metaphor--noun.def: A way of describing something as if it were another thing.
metaphor--noun.ex: The poem uses a sea metaphor.

frontier--noun.def: The border between two countries, or the edge of knowledge.
frontier--noun.ex: They crossed the frontier at night.

greatness--noun.def: The quality of being very important or very good.
greatness--noun.exTr: Tarih onun büyüklüğünü sonradan takdir etti.

vanity--noun.def: Too much pride in your own looks or abilities.
vanity--noun.ex: Vanity blinded him to the truth.

secondly--adv.def: Used to introduce the second point.
secondly--adv.ex: Secondly, the cost is too high.

chimney--noun.def: The pipe that takes smoke out of a building.

packet--noun.def: A small container made of paper or plastic.

rhyme--verb.def: To end with the same sound as another word.

equation--noun.def: A mathematical statement that two amounts are equal.

heap--noun.ex: A heap of sand blocked the gate.

heap--verb.def: To put things in an untidy pile.
heap--verb.ex: She heaped rice on his plate.

catastrophe--noun.def: A terrible event causing great damage.

privately--adv.def: Not in public, or paid for by a person rather than the state.
privately--adv.ex: They spoke privately for an hour.

consolation--noun.def: Comfort given to someone who is sad.

astonishing--adj.def: So surprising that it is hard to believe.

berry--noun.def: A small soft fruit with seeds inside.
berry--noun.ex: The bush is full of berries.

coral--noun.def: A hard substance formed by tiny sea animals.
coral--noun.ex: The coral is losing its colour.

conductor--noun.def: A person who leads an orchestra or collects fares.
conductor--noun.ex: The conductor bowed to the players.

dispute--noun.def: A serious disagreement, often a formal one.

bind--verb.def: To tie things together, or to make an agreement binding.
bind--verb.ex: They bound the papers with string.

polo--noun.def: A game played on horseback with long sticks and a ball.
polo--noun.ex: He learned polo as a boy.

download--noun.def: A file taken from the internet onto your device.

convert--verb.def: To change something into a different form or use.
convert--verb.ex: They converted the barn into a house.

unload--verb.def: To take goods off a vehicle.

thesis--noun.def: A long piece of research writing for a degree.
thesis--noun.ex: Her thesis runs to two hundred pages.

weary--adj.def: Very tired, especially after long effort.

employ--verb.def: To pay someone to work, or to use a method.
employ--verb.ex: The factory employs four hundred people.
employ--verb.exTr: Fabrika dört yüz kişi istihdam ediyor.

stool--noun.def: A seat with no back and no arms.
stool--noun.ex: He sat on a wooden stool.

postpone--verb.def: To move an event to a later time.

extensive--adj.def: Covering a large area or including much detail.

urgently--adv.def: In a way that needs immediate attention.
